question: Which Amendment gave Constitutional recognition to the National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**102nd Amendment Act, 2018**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **102nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2018** provided constitutional status to the **National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC).**
 
• This amendment introduced **Article 338B** in the Indian Constitution, which specifically deals with the **structure, duties, and powers** of the NCBC.
 
• It also amended **Article 342A**, which empowers the President to specify the socially and educationally backward classes in consultation with the Governor of the concerned state. *Hence, the statement is correct.*
